versions.content: If a routing activation request message is received with a valid “Source address” b ut the connection this Routing activation was received on is already registered to another source address, the DoIP module shall send a routing activation response message (see chapter 7.3.2.3.2 ) on the same connection the r equest was received on, with the routing activation response code set to 0x02. Additionally the socket connection shall be closed as defined in SWS_DoIP_00058.

If a routing activation request message is received with a valid "Source address" but the connection this Routing activation was received on is already registered to another source address, the DoIP module shall send a routing activation response message (see chapter 7.3.2.3.2) on the same connection the request was received on, with the routing activation response code set to 0x02. Additionally the socket connection shall be closed as defined in SWS_DoIP_00058.
